top_signals.title: Lula Set to Announce Bradesco’s Trabuco as Finance Minister
top_signals.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is set to announce Bradesco Chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco Cappi as finance minister, according to people familiar with the matter, turning to one of Brazil’s best-known bankers to restore investor confidence in the nation’s finances.

top_signals.title: How Europe Comes Apart
top_signals.summary: The European Union is entering a period of political instability that could threaten its future—not through its formal dissolution, but through the gradual erosion of its capacity to act. In recent months, Europe has been engulfed in protests driven by a common crisis of affordability, deteriorating public services, and declining confidence in governments’ ability to improve living standards, especially for young people.

top_signals.title: Cold Snap Squeezes UK Spare Power Capacity
top_signals.summary: The UK faces a system margin shortfall of more than 2.7 gigawatts (GW) between noon and 8 p.m. local time on Thursday, as the cold snap is reducing the margin of spare capacity for the third day in a row.  The UK’s National Energy System Operator (NESO) issued early on Thursday an electricity margin notice, which encourages market actions to increase system margins.   Electricity Margin Notices are used to send a signal to the electricity market.
